notes: Mass card art for Sovereign Dawn (units, pets, buildings, tactics, equipment, workers). Prompts are built mechanically from each gameplay card's name, element and lore, so a card's art follows its design; hero-quality art (sisters, bounds, dragons) stays hand-directed.

cardart.style: painterly high-fantasy trading-card illustration, rich saturated colour, dramatic lighting, crisp readable silhouette, detailed but uncluttered, centred composition with clear space around the subject

Wind.fx: spiralling wind ribbons and drifting feathers

Light.fx: warm rays of golden light and glowing motes

Darkness.fx: curling shadow smoke and faint spectral wisps

Poison.color: toxic orchid magenta and acid lime
Poison.fx: wisps of toxic vapour and bubbling droplets

Neutral.color: warm steel grey, oak brown and soft gold
Neutral.fx: soft dust and gentle golden light

units.framing: a full-body character shown in a dynamic three-quarter action pose, weapon and gear clearly visible
units.background: a dramatic battlefield landscape in the element's colours, softly out of focus

pets.framing: a full-body creature shown in a powerful, alert pose, anatomy and markings clearly visible
pets.background: a wild landscape suited to the creature, in the element's colours, softly out of focus

buildings.framing: a single structure shown from a slightly raised three-quarter exterior view, with a few tiny workers and props for scale
buildings.background: a fantasy settlement and its surroundings at golden hour, softly out of focus

tactics.framing: the moment the tactic takes effect, shown as a dramatic effect-driven action scene with small silhouetted soldiers for scale
tactics.background: a battlefield sky and terrain lit by the effect itself

equipment.framing: a single item shown large and centred like a museum still life, with fine material detail and a slight glow
equipment.background: a dark, softly lit surface with a faint element-coloured glow behind the item

workers.framing: a working person at their trade, shown full-body with their tools and a hint of what they produce
workers.background: their workplace in a fantasy settlement at a warm time of day, softly out of focus
